title: Timeline and Branching Epic: navigable multi-month timelines, time-locked memory, and scenario branching
goal: Implement the 14/11 2026 Timeline Vision Guide across engine, memory, simulation, and UI.

sections.what: Phases 1-2 (Commons calendar timestamps, branching/reset, future-memory recall locking in engine/memory_retrieval.py) are complete. Remaining epic scope (Phases 3-4): scenario-level branch graph, entity existence windows, timeline-aware run_sim/soak/timeskip/PlayMode, and multi-month Timeline UI.
sections.why: Authors and players need to jump around scenario chronology (e.g., rewind 6 months to May or August), test alternate character decisions without destroying the main timeline, and guarantee characters cannot recall future events.
sections.how:
1. Phase 1 (task-976, task-977): Dated world_datetime memories, future-memory recall lock, and calendar/phone timestamps in Commons.
2. Phase 2 (task-978, task-979): Commons standalone mode, branching/reset, and anchored real-time/manual date-time clock.
3. Phase 3: Scenario branch graph (branch_id, parent_branch_id, fork_datetime), entity existence tracking, edit incorporation, and timeline-aware run_sim, soak, timeskip, and PlayMode with strict branch isolation and default save/load.
4. Phase 4: Zoomable, scrollable, searchable, filterable multi-month Timeline UI with hover event inspection and EventStream unification/replacement.
sections.verify: Verify branch isolation (no future memory leaks, no cross-branch contamination), save/load round-trip of timeline trees, and live UI scrubbing/forking/PlayMode entry.

acceptance.text: Jumping backward in time denies recall of memories dated after the active clock.
Forking a branch at any point isolates subsequent edits, character decisions, entity existence, soak, and timeskip from sibling branches.
Timeline tree saves and loads by default with scenarios and provides zoomable, scrollable, searchable, filterable navigation.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Docked Log | Timeline toggle inside #event-section (#timeline-branch-bar) and full TimelineView modal with Branches | Characters swimlanes, zoomable/scrollable/searchable/filterable navigation, hover event inspection, Fork & Soak, and Expand Prequel Earlier.

Manual verification steps:
1. Load a scenario, click Timeline in #timeline-branch-bar (or open the full modal), switch between Branches and Characters swimlanes, and inspect hover tooltips.
2. Scrub or expand earlier, fork a branch or run Fork & Soak, and verify future memories are locked and sibling branches stay isolated.

evidence: pytest tests/test_timeline_vision_complete.py tests/test_timeline.py tests/test_stream_store.py tests/test_timeline_e2e.py tests/test_commons.py tests/test_agent_python_loop.py -q: 43 passed
